description_en: Set to `false` to disable prompt suggestions (the "Prompt suggestions" toggle in `/config`). These are the grayed-out predictions that appear in your prompt input after Claude responds. See [Prompt suggestions](/en/interactive-mode#prompt-suggestions)
description_ja: falseに設定すると、回答後に表示される薄い灰色の予測テキスト(プロンプト提案)を無効にします。
